memberships.page_title: The Regular-Jordan Collision Family in Dimension Five
Regular Full-Kernel Pencils as Binary Sextics
Can the Dimension-Five First-Normal Obstruction Be Globalized?

statement: An explicit smooth Z11 residue disk in the regular Jordan-type-(5) collision-line locus cannot extend even to first normal order to a global homogeneous quadratic nilpotent 5 by 5 Jacobian; transformed and coordinate-free exact systems have ranks (60,61) and (125,126), respectively.
